tut-empty.zh: 状态：Brio、GPose、后端、显存、内存。绿色正常，悬停看详情
tut-empty.en: Status: Brio, GPose, backend, VRAM, RAM. Green is fine; hover for details

tut-empty.zh: 图库：导入、分类、批量识别
把当前图存入图库（附带修正）
tut-empty.en: Save the current image to the library (with corrections)

tut-empty.zh: 辅助视角：挂上同一动作其他角度的图
tut-empty.en: Extra views: attach other angles of the same pose

tut-empty.zh: 要摆姿势的角色（默认 GPose 目标）
tut-empty.en: Character to pose (GPose target by default)

tut-empty.zh: 启动 / 停止识别后端
角色列表：多个角色各绑一张图
tut-empty.en: Character list: one image per character

tut-empty.zh: 种族骨架（按角色外貌自动识别）
图像 / 3D / 调整 / 提示 / 设置
把图片拖到这里，或点一下从图库选
tut-empty.en: Drop an image here, or click to pick from the library

tut-empty.zh: 导出 .pose / 存到 Brio 姿势库
tut-empty.en: Export .pose / save to the Brio pose library

tut-empty.zh: 勾上：松开滑杆自动应用
tut-empty.en: Checked: apply when you release a slider

tut-empty.zh: 交流群与赞助（所有功能免费，赞助自愿）

tut-image.zh: 绿线：从照片识别出的骨架
tut-image.en: Green: skeleton recognized from the photo

tut-image.zh: 橙线：换算到你的种族后的 FF14 骨架
tut-image.en: Orange: the FF14 skeleton for your race

tut-image.zh: 满意就点这里应用到角色
tut-image.en: Happy with it? Apply to the character

tut-image.zh: 两套骨架可以分别显示 / 隐藏
(!) 表示有骨架提示，悬停查看
tut-image.en: (!) means there are skeleton notes; hover to read

tut-image.zh: 识别用时；同一张图再打开直接读缓存
tut-image.en: Recognition time; reopening the same image uses the cache

tut-3d.zh: 在游戏里编辑：GPose 里直接拖角色身上的点（见第 18 节）
tut-3d.en: Edit in game: drag points on the character in GPose (section 18)

tut-3d.zh: 保存修正：偏移和调整页的数值跟着这张图走
tut-3d.en: Save correction: offsets and tuning values stay with this image

tut-3d.zh: 点关节选中，下方出现微调滑杆
tut-3d.en: Click a joint to select it and show fine-tuning sliders

tut-3d.zh: 黄 / 红点：角度超出游戏常见范围
tut-3d.en: Yellow / red dots: angles outside the usual in-game range

tut-3d.zh: 拖动旋转，滚轮缩放，双击复位
tut-3d.en: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, double-click to reset

tut-3d.zh: 叠加显示识别骨架做对比
tut-3d.en: Overlay the recognized skeleton to compare

tut-tuning.zh: 保存修正：这张图调好的值存进这张图
tut-tuning.en: Save correction: keep this image's values

tut-tuning.zh: 预设：照片 / 插画（插画的颈、头幅度更小）
tut-tuning.en: Preset: photo / illustration (smaller neck and head)

tut-tuning.zh: 幅度：1 = 照片原样，<1 收敛，>1 夸张。右键恢复默认
tut-tuning.en: Amplitude: 1 = as in the photo, <1 calmer, >1 stronger. Right-click to reset

tut-tuning.zh: 手部接触、站姿重力校正与贴地、辅助骨联动
tut-tuning.en: Hand contact, stance (gravity, ground) and helper bones

tut-hints.zh: 骨架提示（这里是离线截图，没有读到游戏角色）
tut-hints.en: Skeleton note (offline screenshot, no game character read)

tut-hints.zh: 红色：明显超出游戏常见范围
tut-hints.en: Red: well outside the usual in-game range

tut-hints.zh: 点一下按建议调整幅度
tut-hints.en: Click to apply the suggested amplitude
Yellow: a bit large, worth a look

tut-settings.zh: 第一次使用：选择后端一键包解压后的目录
tut-settings.en: First time: choose the folder you unzipped the backend package to

tut-settings.zh: 路径有效、后端已是最新
tut-settings.en: Path valid, backend up to date

tut-settings.zh: 插件加载时自动启动后端
tut-settings.en: Start the backend when the plugin loads

tut-settings.zh: 识别设备：自动会在显存不够时改用 CPU
tut-settings.en: Device: Auto falls back to CPU when VRAM is short

tut-settings.zh: 模型释放：常驻更快，立即释放省显存
tut-settings.en: Model release: keep loaded is faster, release saves VRAM

tut-library.zh: 导入图片（复制进当前文件夹）

tut-library.en: Paste an image from the clipboard

tut-library.zh: 添加已有的图片文件夹（不复制）
tut-library.en: Add an existing image folder (not copied)

tut-library.zh: 绿勾：已识别，打开不用再等
tut-library.en: Green check: already recognized, opens instantly

tut-library.zh: 双击打开到主窗口；右键：识别、辅助视角、标签、移动、删除…
tut-library.en: Double-click to open in the main window; right-click: recognize, extra views, tags, move, delete…

tut-split.en: Dock to the right of the main window

tut-split.zh: 从图库把图拖到格子里绑定
tut-split.en: Drag an image from the library onto the box

tut-split.zh: 编辑：切到主窗口细调这个角色
tut-split.en: Edit: fine-tune this character in the main window

tut-split.zh: 全部应用：每张图用自己保存的修正
tut-split.en: Apply all: each image uses its own saved correction

tut-split.zh: 主窗口的这个按钮打开角色列表
tut-split.en: This button opens the character list

tut-aux.zh: 最好是约 90° 的侧面；背面、角度相近的帮助不大
tut-aux.en: A ~90° side view works best; back views and similar angles help little

tut-aux.zh: 从文件添加（复制，不进图库网格）
tut-aux.en: Add from files (copied, kept out of the library grid)

tut-editor.zh: 完成：改动存进这张图的修正；取消：放弃这次的全部改动；教程：随时再看
tut-editor.en: Done: edits go into this image's corrections; Cancel: discard this session's edits; Tutorial: open it any time

tut-editor.zh: 状态：选中了谁、手贴不上时的原因
tut-editor.en: Status: what is selected, why a hand could not be placed

tut-editor.zh: 对称编辑、限制在正常范围内、一直显示手指
tut-editor.en: Symmetric editing, keep within normal range, always show fingers

tut-editor.zh: 手部吸附：拖手靠近身体时手掌贴上去；贴合度从松到压紧
tut-editor.en: Hand snapping: the palm settles on a body you drag the hand near; fit goes from loose to pressed in

tut-editor.zh: 贴到部位：实验功能（黄色感叹号）
tut-editor.en: Place on body part: experimental (yellow mark)

tut-editor.zh: 选中骨骼的 X / Y / Z 角度：左右拖调整，Ctrl+单击输入
tut-editor.en: X / Y / Z angles of the selected bone: drag, or Ctrl+click to type
